title: Haunted Montreal Pub Crawl
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Please Note: The June 28 Haunted Pub Crawl will be different.

Due to Team Canada playing in the World Cup, the special private areas we use in two of the three bars on the tour are unavailable to us, so instead, the first portion will be a walking tour, passing in front of bars and other haunted areas, hearing ghost stories outdoors in alleys and on the sidewalk, still in the same few block radius.

Then it will end at our regular final spot, inside Hurley's Irish Pub on lower Crescent street. You'll be able to sample the Headless Mary Shooter, and get other drinks as you listen to more famous Montreal ghost stories.
